## Transparent assets

Prompts for native RGBA output, stickers and cutout-ready graphics with real alpha transparency.

<a id="native-rgba-cartoon-sticker"></a>

### Generate a Cartoon Sticker With Native Transparency

[![Transparent-background Qwen-Image 2.1 example shared with the recommended RGBA prompt format](<https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HSrYnSHawAEspon.jpg>)](<https://x.com/PhotoX86/status/2101731412193984838>)

Use Qwen's recommended RGBA wording to create a cutout-style asset with an alpha channel instead of a baked background.

**Model:** Qwen-Image 2.1 · **Mode:** generate · **Inputs:** None

#### Prompt

**Official prompt template** · `en`

```text
This is an RGBA image with transparency. A cute cartoon dragon sticker. The image has alpha channel and the background is transparent.
```

#### How to adapt it

Keep the opening and closing transparency sentences, then replace the middle description with your asset. Export as PNG or another format that preserves alpha.

**Shared by:** [PhotoX86](<https://x.com/PhotoX86>)

[Original post on X](<https://x.com/PhotoX86/status/2101731412193984838>) · [View in the MagicCreator gallery](<https://magiccreator.ai/qwen-image-2-1-prompts#native-rgba-cartoon-sticker>)

<a id="multi-reference"></a>

## Multi-reference composition

Workflows that assign clear roles to several reference images and combine them into one scene.

<a id="nine-reference-office-design"></a>

### Furnish One Office With Nine Product References

[![Office interior assembled in Qwen Image 2.1 from nine furniture reference images](<https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HSpuj0eaEAA6qvP.jpg>)](<https://x.com/junwatu/status/2101614052514627935>)

Assign one role to each reference image while preserving the room, camera and architecture as the fixed scene.

**Model:** Qwen-Image 2.1 · **Mode:** edit · **Inputs:** 10 images

#### Prompt

**Original prompt** · `en`

```text
Using the empty wooden office room shown in the prompt as the fixed scene, and the furniture/decor in <image1> through <image9> as individual product references, generate a brand-new fully furnished modern office interior. Preserve the room's architecture, proportions, camera position, perspective, windows, door, wood floor, wood-paneled ceiling, warm walls and lighting. Place the executive desk from <image9> against the back wall, the chair from <image1> behind it, the sofa from <image2> along the right side, the coffee table from <image3> in front of the sofa, the bookshelf from <image4> on the back-left wall, the floor lamp from <image5> beside the sofa, the rug from <image6> beneath the seating area, the plant from <image7> in the near-left corner, and the side table from <image8> beside the sofa. Each image is only a reference for its assigned object. Do not copy rooms, people, lighting or surrounding objects from the product references. Preserve each object's shape, proportions, material, color and distinctive details. Scale everything naturally, with realistic contact shadows, perspective and occlusion. The result should look like a professionally photographed, warm, minimal contemporary studio office.
```

#### How to adapt it

Number every reference, give each image exactly one job, define which scene stays fixed, and explicitly forbid borrowing backgrounds or lighting from object references.

**Shared by:** [DΞV](<https://x.com/junwatu>)

[Original post on X](<https://x.com/junwatu/status/2101614052514627935>) · [View in the MagicCreator gallery](<https://magiccreator.ai/qwen-image-2-1-prompts#nine-reference-office-design>)

<a id="official-multi-character-campfire"></a>

### Combine Three Character References Around a Campfire

A minimal official multi-reference instruction that gives three supplied characters one shared action and environment.

**Model:** Qwen-Image 2.1 · **Mode:** edit · **Inputs:** 3 images

#### Prompt

**Official quick-start prompt** · `en`

```text
These three characters are sitting around a campfire in a forest
```

#### How to adapt it

Keep the subject count aligned with the uploaded references, then state one shared action and one environment. Add identity-preservation rules only when the references are easy to confuse.

**Shared by:** Qwen

<a id="text-and-layout"></a>

## Text and layout

Prompts for typography, posters, infographics and layout-sensitive images.

<a id="research-lab-whiteboard"></a>

### Test Dense Typography With a Research Whiteboard

[![Qwen Image 2.1 whiteboard typography test with labels, chart and laboratory props](<https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HSq7ybbXkAAThML.jpg>)](<https://x.com/guitaripod/status/2101698690117259745>)

Stress-test exact labels, numbered instructions, a chart and physical props inside one realistic photograph.

**Model:** Qwen-Image 2.1 · **Mode:** generate · **Inputs:** None

#### Prompt

**Original prompt** · `en`

```text
A wide realistic photograph of a research lab whiteboard at night, seen straight on, in a cool grey and amber palette. Across the top, a bold black hand-lettered headline reads "CALIBRATION RUN 7", underlined twice. On the left, four numbered blue-marker lines read "1. warm the sensor", "2. zero the scale", "3. log the drift", and "4. repeat at 40C". In the centre, a hand-drawn line chart on a faint grid rises left to right; the x-axis reads "minutes" and the y-axis reads "drift (mV)", with three red crosses and a dashed tolerance band. On the right, a red circled note reads "DO NOT ERASE". A steel tray holds five markers and a chipped enamel mug. A wall clock reads twenty past four. A young woman in a grey knitted jumper stands in profile at the far right, lit from below by her tablet. One hard overhead strip light creates a narrow reflection on the board. Orderly, symmetrical, quiet and clinical.
```

#### How to adapt it

Quote every required string, attach each string to a clear region, then describe the overall visual hierarchy and lighting after the copy requirements.

**Shared by:** [ᛗᚨᚱᚴᚢᛋ](<https://x.com/guitaripod>)

[Original post on X](<https://x.com/guitaripod/status/2101698690117259745>) · [View in the MagicCreator gallery](<https://magiccreator.ai/qwen-image-2-1-prompts#research-lab-whiteboard>)

<a id="character-style-infographic"></a>

### Turn a Portrait Into a Character Style Infographic

[![Magazine-style character infographic generated with Qwen Image 2.1](<https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HSjK_whb0AAu4RH.jpg>)](<https://x.com/junwatu/status/2101152432248295795>)

Build a magazine-style profile poster with a preserved face, fixed title bar, information cards, swatches and a radar chart.

**Model:** Qwen-Image 2.1 · **Mode:** edit · **Inputs:** 1 image

#### Prompt

**Original prompt structure** · `en`

```text
Use the close-up photo as a reference. Transform it into a Japanese magazine-style character infographic poster while strictly preserving the subject's face, facial features and identity. Use a moon-white background with a light gray grid. Reserve a horizontal title bar at the top with the title "Moon-White Veil Whispers", subtitle "VOL.05 · Cool-Toned Art" and badge "Portrait Special". Lower and center the full-body portrait so it never overlaps the title bar. Arrange information cards in left and right columns and along the bottom. Dress the subject in a white off-shoulder organza dress with a black satin waist ribbon and high updo. Include clearly separated cards for Personal Profile, Accessory Details, Character Timeline, Attribute Cards, Garment Details, Color Palette, Personality Tags, Recommended Settings and Style Keywords. Use elegant serif display type for the title and highly legible sans-serif body type. Keep every requested word inside its card, correctly spelled, with no extra text, gibberish or distorted characters.
```

#### How to adapt it

Keep the non-overlap and identity rules, then replace the title, wardrobe, card names and exact copy with your own profile. Shorten the card list when legibility matters more than density.

**Shared by:** [DΞV](<https://x.com/junwatu>)

[Original post on X](<https://x.com/junwatu/status/2101152432248295795>) · [View in the MagicCreator gallery](<https://magiccreator.ai/qwen-image-2-1-prompts#character-style-infographic>)

<a id="precise-edits"></a>

## Precise edits

Prompts that define a narrow change while protecting the rest of an image.

<a id="1985-portrait-restyle"></a>

### Restyle a Portrait as an Authentic 1985 Photo

[![1985 portrait restyle result shared from a Qwen Image 2.1 comparison](<https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HSqr56vWoAA4OzT.jpg>)](<https://x.com/VictorMotricala/status/2101682379542741045>)

Change hair, clothing and surroundings while explicitly protecting identity, facial features, skin tone and age.

**Model:** Qwen-Image 2.1 · **Mode:** edit · **Inputs:** 1 image

#### Prompt

**Original prompt** · `en`

```text
Using my uploaded photo, show me what I would have looked like around 1985. Preserve my identity, facial features, skin tone, age, and recognizable appearance. Reimagine my hair, clothing, accessories, and surroundings with bold, unmistakably mid-1980s styling—expressive silhouettes, statement accessories, layered details, distinctive colors, and textures. Make it feel like a genuine 1985 photograph with analog grain, faded color, direct flash, and subtle softness. Add a period-accurate 1980s red-orange date stamp in the lower corner. No recognizable posters. No modern objects or text.
```

#### How to adapt it

Swap the decade and its visual markers, but keep identity protection in the first sentence. Name both period cues to add and modern details to exclude.

**Shared by:** [Victor Motricala](<https://x.com/VictorMotricala>)

[Original post on X](<https://x.com/VictorMotricala/status/2101682379542741045>) · [View in the MagicCreator gallery](<https://magiccreator.ai/qwen-image-2-1-prompts#1985-portrait-restyle>)

<a id="creative-generation"></a>

## Creative generation

Open-ended prompts for testing detail, style and composition.

<a id="folded-dream-city"></a>

### Create a Folded Dream City Panorama

[![Wide folded dream city generated locally with Qwen Image 2.1](<https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HSkp5FPXEAAtEob.jpg>)](<https://x.com/ivanfioravanti/status/2101257247292580045>)

Describe impossible geometry as one continuous environment while locking the cinematic palette, materials and camera language.

**Model:** Qwen-Image 2.1 · **Mode:** generate · **Inputs:** None

#### Prompt

**Original prompt** · `en`

```text
A city street bends upward at the horizon: the ground and its buildings curve up from street level and arc into the sky like a giant wave, one single continuous landscape where skyscrapers grow progressively more vertical until they tower overhead, the road itself rising and wrapping up into the clouds. Dream physics like a folded dream city: no mirror duplication, just one seamless city rolling from horizontal to vertical. Wet reflective asphalt, cool blue-grey palette with warm window lights, glass and steel towers, low clouds threading between the rising districts, slight lens distortion, IMAX 70mm film look, cinematic wide-angle, photorealistic, volumetric haze, epic impossible scale.
```

#### How to adapt it

Replace the city with another environment, but keep the single-continuous-world rule to prevent mirrored or duplicated geometry. Finish with lens, palette and atmosphere.

**Shared by:** [Ivan Fioravanti](<https://x.com/ivanfioravanti>)

[Original post on X](<https://x.com/ivanfioravanti/status/2101257247292580045>) · [View in the MagicCreator gallery](<https://magiccreator.ai/qwen-image-2-1-prompts#folded-dream-city>)

<a id="hard-sci-fi-lithography-machine"></a>

### Render a Hard-Sci-Fi Lithography Machine

[![Hard-science-fiction lithography machine generated with Qwen Image 2.1](<https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HSrBJ6Jb0AAUvcO.jpg>)](<https://x.com/JiaMiXingTuan/status/2101706227139199441>)

Combine a concise style block with a specific industrial subject to produce a detailed widescreen science-fiction concept.

**Model:** Qwen-Image 2.1 · **Mode:** generate · **Inputs:** None

#### Prompt

**Original prompt** · `en`

```text
Cinematic sci-fi concept art, realistic hard sci-fi, deep space survival, lonely astronaut atmosphere, clean industrial design, blue cold lighting, subtle golden cultivation energy, minimalistic futuristic engineering, realistic materials, advanced experimental lithography machine, white cleanroom equipment, ultraviolet optical system, precision mechanical platform.
```

#### How to adapt it

Keep the first half as the art direction and replace the final equipment list with a different technical subject. Use a few material and lighting constraints instead of a long narrative.
